title: forecaster.metrics.symmetric_mean_absolute_percentage_error
---



```python
forecaster.metrics.symmetric_mean_absolute_percentage_error(y_true, y_pred)
```

Compute the Symmetric Mean Absolute Percentage Error (SMAPE).

SMAPE is a relative error metric used to measure the accuracy
of forecasts. Unlike MAPE, it is symmetric and prevents division
by zero by averaging the absolute values of actual and predicted values.

The result is expressed as a percentage and ranges from 0%
(perfect prediction) to 200% (maximum error).

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name   | Type                                                                                 | Description                              | Default    |
|--------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------------------------------------|------------|
| y_true | [np](`numpy`).[ndarray](`numpy.ndarray`) \| [pd](`pandas`).[Series](`pandas.Series`) | True values of the target variable.      | _required_ |
| y_pred | [np](`numpy`).[ndarray](`numpy.ndarray`) \| [pd](`pandas`).[Series](`pandas.Series`) | Predicted values of the target variable. | _required_ |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type             | Description                  |
|--------|------------------|------------------------------|
|        | [float](`float`) | SMAPE value as a percentage. |

## Examples {.doc-section .doc-section-examples}


::: {#eb3e3b09 .cell execution_count=1}
``` {.python .cell-code}
import numpy as np
from spotforecast2_safe.forecaster.metrics import (
    symmetric_mean_absolute_percentage_error,
)

y_true = np.array([100, 200, 0])
y_pred = np.array([110, 180, 10])
result = symmetric_mean_absolute_percentage_error(y_true, y_pred)
print(0 <= result <= 200)
```
